children: Dr. Raza Bokhari, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Medicus Pharma Ltd., disclosed a 5.3% stake in the company’s common shares. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 14, 2026, detailing direct holdings, stock options, and shares held through RBx Capital, LP. The position reflects his dual role as leader and investor and could shape decisions on strategy and financing.

Bokhari holds the stake for investment and acts through his roles as CEO and Executive Chairman. He "participates in the management and direction of the business" and discusses and votes on strategy, capitalization, financing, board and management composition, corporate structure, and strategic alternatives.

He may buy more shares or sell holdings over time, including through option exercises, open‑market trades, issuer transactions, or Rule 10b5‑1 plans, and he expects additional equity awards as compensation. He also "regularly considers strategy, capitalization, and strategic alternatives" in ongoing board and management discussions.

Dr. Raza Bokhari is a healthcare executive who serves as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Medicus Pharma Ltd. He also manages RBx Capital, LP, a Delaware limited partnership focused on holding and managing investments. Bokhari has led and invested in biopharma ventures, concentrating on clinical development and growth strategies.
